verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Lithic's Auth Rules engine supports a 3DS authentication event stream, so 3DS decisioning is programmable through the API. Card creation is also API-driven. Nothing in the pack covers PIN set or reset flows, or how cardholders are enrolled in 3DS. Missing for 10: PIN set/reset API endpoints, 3DS enrollment management, region-specific 3DS handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
